title: LLMdoctor: Token-Level Flow-Guided Preference Optimization for Efficient Test-Time Alignment of Large Language Models
venueFull: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI)
abstract: We propose LLMdoctor, a novel token-level flow-guided preference optimization method for efficient test-time alignment of large language models. Our approach achieves superior performance in aligning LLMs with human preferences while maintaining computational efficiency.

title: Flow-guided Direct Preference Optimization for Knowledge Graph Reasoning with Trees
venueFull: Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR)
abstract: We propose a flow-guided direct preference optimization method for knowledge graph reasoning with tree structures. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple knowledge graph question answering benchmarks.

title: Insight at the Right Spot: Provide Decisive Subgraph Information to Graph LLM with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning-based method to provide decisive subgraph information to Graph LLMs. Our approach significantly improves the reasoning capabilities of LLMs on graph-structured data.

title: Reasoning with Trees: Faithful Question Answering over Knowledge Graph
venueFull: Proceedings of the 31st International Conference on Computational Linguistics (COLING)
abstract: We propose a tree-based reasoning framework for faithful question answering over knowledge graphs. Our method ensures interpretable and reliable reasoning paths.

title: Knowledge Distillation via Adaptive Meta-Learning for Graph Neural Network
abstract: We propose an adaptive meta-learning approach for knowledge distillation in graph neural networks. Our method effectively transfers knowledge from large GNN models to smaller ones while maintaining performance.

title: Hop-level Direct Preference Optimization for Knowledge Graph Reasoning with Trees
venueFull: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
abstract: We propose a hop-level direct preference optimization method for knowledge graph reasoning with tree structures. Our approach improves multi-hop reasoning capabilities.

title: Graphs get Personal: Learning Representation with Contextual Pretraining for Collaborative Filtering
abstract: We propose a contextual pretraining approach for learning graph representations in collaborative filtering. Our method improves recommendation performance by capturing user-item interactions more effectively.
